paper_title: TL;DR Too Long, Do Re-weighting for Effcient LLM Reasoning Compression
caption: Comparison of accuracy and generation length between Vanilla CoT and our method on four benchmark datasets (GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, AMC) using DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen models. consistently reduces generation length while maintaining or improving accuracy across both 7B and 14B model scales.

model_annotations.German: The bar chart illustrates a comparison of generation length between "Vanilla CoT" and "TLDR (Ours)" across four categories, namely GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, and AMC, using the DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B model. The categories are listed on the horizontal axis, while the vertical axis represents the "Generation Length (words)" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 8000, marked at intervals of 1000. Each category is represented by a pair of bars, with "Vanilla CoT" depicted in light red and "TLDR (Ours)" in dark red. The generation lengths for "Vanilla CoT" are approximately 679, 2951, 6701, and 4584 for GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, and AMC, respectively, while the corresponding values for "TLDR (Ours)" are around 237, 2036, 6434, and 3854. The bars for "TLDR (Ours)" are consistently shorter than their "Vanilla CoT" counterparts, with percentage decreases of -65%, -31%, -4%, and -16% labeled above each pair. The bars are grouped by category, with no specific sorting order, and the "TLDR (Ours)" bars are visually distinguished by their darker color.
